faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: While appointments are recommended, we also accept walk-in patients. However, appointments ensure minimal waiting time.

faqs.question: What insurance do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept most major insurance providers. Please contact us for specific details about your insurance plan.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment through our website, call us at +254 748 662082, or send an email to mwikimodern@gmail.com.
